title: اختبار تدريبي على اختبار شهر نوفمبر - Math - الصف الأول الإعدادي لغات
scope: Algebra (Unit 2): Mathematical Expressions and Formulas, Linear Equations. Geometry: Types of Angles and Relations between Angles (up to vertically opposite angles and accumulative angles at a point), Parallelism.
source: Scope from the Math supervisor's «تحديد شهر نوفمبر» (2026-11-24). Questions follow the Student's Book 2026/2027 and the ministry «كتاب الأداءات والتقييمات» (Math), term 1.

questions.text: The number of terms in the algebraic expression 3xy + 6y − 8x + 9 is ......
questions.explanation: The terms are 3xy, 6y, −8x and 9: four terms separated by + and − signs.

questions.text: The constant term in the expression 5x − 2y + 7 is ......
questions.explanation: The constant term is the term with no variable: 7.

questions.text: Which pair of terms are like terms?
questions.explanation: Like terms have the same variables with the same powers, like 7x and x. 2x² and 2x have different powers.

questions.text: The simplest form of 6m + 2n − 12m + 10n is ......
questions.explanation: Collect like terms: 6m − 12m = −6m and 2n + 10n = 12n.

questions.text: The simplest form of 3x − 6y + 4(2x − 5y) is ......
questions.explanation: Remove the bracket first: 4(2x − 5y) = 8x − 20y, then add: 3x + 8x = 11x and −6y − 20y = −26y.

questions.text: The value of 4x + 3x − 5x when x = 2 is ......
questions.explanation: Simplify first: 4x + 3x − 5x = 2x, and when x = 2 the value is 2 × 2 = 4.

questions.text: The algebraic expression for "subtract x from 1" is ......
questions.explanation: Start with 1 and take x away from it: 1 − x.

questions.text: The value of x in the equation 4x + 2 = 3x − 1 is ......
questions.explanation: Subtract 3x from both sides: x + 2 = −1, then subtract 2: x = −3.

questions.text: The solution set of the equation 3 = x + 5 in N is ......
questions.explanation: The solution is x = −2, which is not a natural number, so the solution set in N is ∅.

questions.text: The solution set of the equation 2x + 7 = 3 in Z is ......
questions.explanation: 2x = 3 − 7 = −4, so x = −2, which is an integer.

questions.text: If 2x + 5 = 13, then the value of x − 3 is ......
The solution set of the equation 2(x + 3) = 3(1 − x) in Q is ......
questions.explanation: Remove the brackets: 2x + 6 = 3 − 3x, then 5x = −3, so x = −3/5.

questions.text: Karma is x years old now, and 6 years ago she was 15. The equation that represents this is ......
questions.explanation: Her age 6 years ago is her age now minus 6: x − 6 = 15, so x = 21 years.

questions.text: The sum of two consecutive integers is 59. If the smaller one is n, the equation is ......
questions.explanation: The integer right after n is n + 1, so n + (n + 1) = 59, which gives n = 29: the integers are 29 and 30.

questions.text: An angle of measure 330° is ......
questions.explanation: A reflex angle measures more than 180° and less than 360°, and 330° is between them.
questions.lesson: Types of Angles and Relations between Angles

questions.text: The complement of an angle of measure 20° measures ......
questions.explanation: Complementary angles add up to 90°: 90° − 20° = 70°. 160° is the measure of its supplement.
questions.lesson: Types of Angles and Relations between Angles

questions.text: Two vertically opposite angles measure (2x)° and (x + 21)°. Each of them measures ......
questions.explanation: Vertically opposite angles are equal: 2x = x + 21, so x = 21 and each angle is 2 × 21° = 42°.
questions.lesson: Types of Angles and Relations between Angles

questions.text: In the figure, A, B and C are on one straight line. The value of x is ......
questions.explanation: Adjacent angles on a straight line add up to 180°: 3x + x + 20 = 180, so 4x = 160 and x = 40.
questions.lesson: Types of Angles and Relations between Angles

questions.text: If two vertically opposite angles are complementary, then each of them measures ......
questions.explanation: Vertically opposite angles are equal, and complementary angles add up to 90°: 90° ÷ 2 = 45°.
questions.lesson: Types of Angles and Relations between Angles

questions.text: The straight lines AB and CD intersect at M. If m(∠AMC) = 70°, then m(∠AMD) = ......
questions.explanation: ∠AMC and ∠AMD are adjacent angles on the straight line CD, so they add up to 180°: 180° − 70° = 110°. The angle equal to 70° is ∠BMD, the vertically opposite angle of ∠AMC.
questions.lesson: Types of Angles and Relations between Angles

questions.text: Four angles are accumulative at a point. Three of them measure 80°, 95° and 110°. The fourth angle measures ......
questions.explanation: The sum of the measures of the accumulative angles at a point is 360°: 360° − (80° + 95° + 110°) = 360° − 285° = 75°.
questions.lesson: Types of Angles and Relations between Angles

questions.text: Four angles are accumulative at a point and their measures are x°, 2x°, 3x° and 4x°. The value of x is ......
questions.explanation: Accumulative angles at a point add up to 360°: x + 2x + 3x + 4x = 360, so 10x = 360 and x = 36.
questions.lesson: Types of Angles and Relations between Angles

questions.text: If a straight line intersects two parallel lines, every two interior angles on the same side of the transversal are ......
questions.explanation: The two interior angles on the same side of the transversal add up to 180°, so they are supplementary.

questions.text: In the figure, M1 // M2 and N is a transversal. The value of x is ......
questions.explanation: The two angles are corresponding angles, so they are equal: x + 10 = 70, so x = 60.

questions.text: In the figure, AB // DC and m(∠A) = 50°. The value of x in degrees is ......
questions.explanation: ∠BAC and ∠DCA are alternate angles, so they are equal: 2x = 50, so x = 25.

questions.text: In the figure, the two horizontal lines are parallel. The value of x is ......
questions.explanation: The two angles are interior angles on the same side of the transversal, so they are supplementary: 110 + x + 30 = 180, so x = 40.

questions.text: If a straight line intersects two straight lines and two alternate angles are equal in measure, then the two straight lines are ......
questions.explanation: If a transversal makes two equal alternate angles with two straight lines, the two lines are parallel.

questions.text: A transversal intersects two parallel straight lines. If one of the two interior angles on the same side of the transversal measures 75°, the other measures ......
questions.explanation: Interior angles on the same side of the transversal are supplementary: 180° − 75° = 105°.

questions.text: A transversal intersects two parallel straight lines. If two alternate angles measure (3x − 20)° and (x + 40)°, then x = ......
questions.explanation: Alternate angles are equal: 3x − 20 = x + 40, so 2x = 60 and x = 30 (each angle is 70°).

questions.text: A transversal intersects two parallel straight lines, forming eight angles. If one of them measures 50°, how many of the eight angles measure 130°?
questions.explanation: Each angle equals its vertically opposite, corresponding and alternate angles, so four angles measure 50° and the other four measure 180° − 50° = 130°.
